questions.q: What courses are offered at SSIT, Bhat?
What is the eligibility for admission to B.E. programs?
questions.a: Students must have passed 12th Science (Group A or A+B) with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Admission is through ACPC (Admission Committee for Professional Courses), Gujarat.
Yes, limited seats are available under the management quota as per GTU and AICTE norms. Visit the admission office for details.

questions.q: How can I apply for admission?
a: Management Quota – Visit SSIT campus for guidance and form filling

questions.q: What documents are required at the time of admission?

questions.a: Approx. fees for B.E. programs is 67200/- per year.

questions.q: What other facilities are available on campus?

questions.a: SSIT is located near Bhat circle, near to Agora Mall and SP Ring Road.

a: On-campus Admission Help Desk available Mon–Sat (10 AM – 5 PM)

sections.title: Why Choose SSIT, Bhat?
points: Reputed Institute under Shree Swaminarayan Group, known for discipline, value-based education & academic excellence.
Affiliated to Gujarat Technological University (GTU) and approved by AICTE.
Experienced Faculty with industry and academic expertise.
State-of-the-Art Infrastructure – Modern labs, digital classrooms, and updated curriculum.
Holistic Development – Technical knowledge combined with moral and spiritual values.
Training & Placement Cell – Regular campus drives, soft skills training, and career support.
Peaceful Campus surrounded by greenery with spiritual ambiance near Swaminarayan Dham.
Transport & Hostel Facility – College buses, girls/boys hostel with all modern amenities.
Student-Centered Approach – Personal mentoring, seminars, industrial visits, and technical events.

sections.title: ❓ GTU vs. Private University – Which is Better?

GTU (Gujarat Technological University).Control & Regulations: Strictly monitored by state govt. & AICTE

Private University.Recognition: Recognized, but depends on university reputation
Private University.Control & Regulations: Independent governance, but must follow UGC norms

sections.conclusion: GTU-affiliated colleges like SSIT offer government-approved structure, lower and regulated fees, strong academic discipline, consistent evaluation system, and wider industry recognition.

sections.title: Computer Engg. vs IT Engg. vs CSE

comparison.Career Paths: Embedded Systems, System Admin, Cybersecurity, Web Dev
Web Dev, DB Admin, IT Support
Software Dev, Data Scientist, AI/ML Engineer, Web Dev

sections.note: All three have overlapping subjects and strong career options. Choose based on interest in theory (CSE), systems (IT), or hardware + software (CE).
